args.name: orderByScore
args.description: Ordering for the associations. Accepts a string with two words separated by a space. The first word is the column to sort by: either `score` to use the overall association score (default), a datasource id (e.g., `impc`), or a datatype id (e.g., `animal_model`). The second word is the order: `desc` (default) or `asc`.
